jobs.title: LVN / LPT Case Manager
jobs.description:
Stronger Roots – Recuperative Care ProgramFull\-Time \| In\-Person

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does not come to work with the mindset:

“I finished my job, so I’m done.”

We want someone who thinks:

“What else needs to happen, and how can I help the team be successful?”

Stronger Roots operates with a small, hands\-on team. You will have your own caseload and responsibilities, but you must also be willing to notice gaps, help with an intake, follow up on an unresolved issue, support a teammate, and step in when the program reasonably needs help.

We need someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates, solves problems, and does not need to be told every next step.

About the Position

Stronger Roots is seeking a California Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) for our Recuperative Care program.

This is not a traditional nursing position. It is a clinical case\-management role combining behavioral\-health support, client engagement, care coordination, documentation, and clinical follow\-up.

Our clients are often more behavioral\-health focused than medically intensive, with mental health, substance\-use, and co\-occurring conditions. Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, although we are willing to train the right candidate.

The position manages approximately 35–40 clients and works closely with our RN, case\-management team, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage a caseload of approximately 35–40 clients.
* Complete and assist with intakes, assessments, care plans, and discharge planning.
* Maintain regular client contact and identify medical, behavioral\-health, substance\-use, and social\-service needs.
* Complete daily progress notes and required case\-management documentation.
* Review medical records, medications, discharge instructions, behavioral\-health information, and provider recommendations.
* Provide clinical support within the LVN/LPT scope of practice and appropriately escalate concerns.
* Coordinate medical care, behavioral health, psychiatry, substance\-use treatment, pharmacy, Home Health, specialty services, and other community resources.
* Coordinate appointments, referrals, transportation, prescriptions, and provider follow\-up.
* Communicate with hospitals, Managed Care Plans, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.
* Participate in case conferences and interdisciplinary team meetings.
* Help clients address barriers involving treatment, medications, benefits, housing, transportation, and recovery.
* Maintain accurate and timely electronic records.

Preferred Experience

Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with individuals with:

* Mental health conditions and serious mental illness
* Substance\-use disorders
* Co\-occurring mental health and substance\-use disorders
* Trauma and behavioral dysregulation
* Medication\-adherence challenges
* Homelessness and housing instability
* Difficulty consistently engaging in treatment

Experience in psychiatric services, behavioral health, substance\-use treatment, crisis services, community mental health, Recuperative Care, homelessness services, or case management is a plus.

Qualifications

* Current California LVN or LPT license
* Strong communication, organization, and follow\-through
* Comfortable managing approximately 35–40 clients
* Strong professional boundaries and client\-engagement skills
* Ability to recognize and appropriately escalate clinical or behavioral\-health concerns
* Strong computer and Electronic Health Record (EHR) skills
* Ability to complete accurate and timely progress notes and electronic documentation
* Comfortable working independently while remaining part of a small interdisciplinary team

Experience with trauma\-informed care, motivational interviewing, de\-escalation, crisis intervention, CPR/First Aid, Narcan, Medi\-Cal/CalAIM, or ECM is preferred.

Important

This is a full\-time, in\-person, boots\-on\-the\-ground position.

It is not a work\-from\-home position and is not intended for someone looking for a second job or simply additional nursing hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to join the team, take ownership of their clients, and help the entire program succeed.

Employment Statement

Stronger Roots is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with Stronger Roots is at will, meaning either the employee or Stronger Roots may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities as required by law.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you agree to read the entire job posting?

Experience:

* Case management or direct patient care: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* LVN /LPT (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: MAT Care Coordinator (Medicated Assisted Treatment)
jobs.description:
SANE is seeking a full\-time MAT Care Coordinator to help participants access its low\-barrier MAT treatment. The Care Coordinator serves as a consistent point of contact for participants and works closely with prescribing physicians, program staff, pharmacies, and community partners.

The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, dependable, and comfortable working with people who experience substance use, homelessness, mental health conditions, and barriers to healthcare. This position requires a nonjudgmental approach and a strong commitment to harm reduction and participant\-centered care.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Welcome and engage participants seeking MAT services.
* Complete intake, screening, enrollment, and other required documentation.
* Utilize Electronic Health Record to schedule and coordinate appointments.
* Provide appointment reminders and follow up with participants who miss appointments.
* Help participants begin, continue, or re\-engage in treatment.
* Coordinate prescriptions and address pharmacy\-related barriers in collaboration with prescribing providers.
* Assist with medication authorizations, coverage issues, and other access barriers.
* Support coordination of injectable or long\-acting medications when applicable.
* Connect participants with primary care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, housing, transportation, benefits, and other supportive services.
* Provide referrals and warm handoffs to community providers.
* Maintain regular communication with physicians and other members of the care team.
* Maintain organized and confidential participant records.
* Follow HIPAA requirements and all organizational confidentiality policies.
* Participate in staff meetings, training, and program improvement activities.
* Complete grant\-specific data requests, documentation, and program reports as assigned by supervisors, ensuring information is accurate and submitted by required deadlines.
* Advocate for participants while supporting their autonomy and treatment choices.
* Assist with daily Syringe Services Program (SSP) operations as needed, including greeting participants, preparing and organizing supplies, referring to other SANE services, and supporting the flow of participant services.
* Assist with receiving, unloading, organizing, and maintaining program supply deliveries, as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* One year experience in care coordination, case management, healthcare, behavioral health, substance use services, social services, or a related field.
* Understanding of, or willingness to learn about, opioid use disorder and medications used to treat it.
* Ability to build trusting relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple participant needs and priorities.
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries and protect confidential information.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to learn electronic documentation systems.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Reliable attendance and ability to work the required schedule.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish and/or other languages.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A relevant associates or Bachelor degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Experience working in a MAT, MOUD, harm reduction, syringe services, homeless services or community based organization.
* Knowledge of buprenorphine, injectable buprenorphine, and other medications for opioid use disorder.
* Experience coordinating services with medical providers, pharmacies, health plans, or community partners
* Familiarity with Medi\-Cal and local health and social\-service systems.
* Experience working with people experiencing homelessness or other barriers to care.
* Community Health Worker, peer\-support, case management or care coordination training.
* Lived or professional experience relevant to the communities SANE serves.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**This position is based at SANE’s service location and includes regular interaction with participants, staff, medical providers, and community partners. The MAT Care Coordinator’s primary role is to support participants in accessing and remaining engaged in MAT services. As part of SANE’s collaborative team, the employee will also assist with daily Syringe Services Program operations and contribute where needed to help meet participant needs and maintain consistent, high\-quality services.The position requires the ability to use a computer and telephone, sit or stand for extended periods, move throughout the service location, and occasionally lift or move program supplies weighing up to 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities.

*SANE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

Pay: $24\.00 \- $26\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.title: Syringe Service Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syringe Services Program (SSP) Coordinator

**Position:** Full\-Time, 40 hours per week

**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**Location:** 2211 Del Paso Blvd

**Compensation:** $29\-$31/hour

Position Summary

The Syringe Services Program (SSP) Coordinator oversees the day\-to\-day operations of the SSP Drop\-In Center. This hands\-on position coordinates staff and volunteers, manages inventory and supplies, prepares harm reduction kits, and delivers supplies to SSP participants.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, compassionate, and committed to providing respectful, confidential, and nonjudgmental harm reduction services.

Essential Duties \& Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily operations of the SSP Drop\-In Center.
* Schedule SSP employees and ensure appropriate program coverage.
* Coordinate and support SSP volunteers.
* Prepare and oversee the assembly of harm reduction kits.
* Maintain accurate inventory of syringes, naloxone, safer\-use materials, and other program supplies.
* Receive, organize, stock, and monitor program supplies.
* Anticipate inventory needs and help prevent supply shortages.
* Prepare and deliver harm reduction supplies to SSP participants.
* Provide respectful, confidential, and nonjudgmental participant services.
* Provide harm reduction and overdose prevention information and connect participants with community resources when appropriate.
* Maintain required program records and documentation.
* Follow confidentiality, bloodborne pathogen, sharps\-handling, and workplace safety procedures.
* Participate in staff meetings, training, and other program activities as needed.

Driving Requirements

Because supply delivery is an essential part of this position, the employee must:

* Possess a valid driver’s license.
* Maintain a driving record that meets organizational requirements.
* Have access to a reliable, insured vehicle for work\-related travel.
* Maintain automobile insurance and meet the organization’s insurability requirements.
* Be willing and able to deliver supplies throughout the program’s service area.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational, communication, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate employees, volunteers, inventory, and daily program activities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic computer and recordkeeping skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Commitment to harm reduction and participant autonomy.
* Ability to work respectfully with people who use drugs and individuals experiencing barriers to traditional services.
* Fluent in Spanish

**Preferred:** Previous experience in syringe services, harm reduction, outreach, public health, social services, staff or volunteer coordination, or inventory management. Knowledge of overdose prevention and naloxone administration is also preferred.

Relevant lived experience is valued.

Physical \& Work Requirements

This position requires regular driving and may involve standing, lifting up to 50lbs on a daily basis, transporting supplies, stocking inventory, and working around syringes and other potentially hazardous materials. Appropriate training and protective equipment will be provided.

Our Approach

Our Syringe Services Program is grounded in harm reduction, dignity, respect, and participant choice. The SSP Coordinator helps ensure participants have consistent access to supplies, information, resources, and support in a welcoming and nonjudgmental environment.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Active Secret Clearance Required
jobs.description:
**MTSI is seeking a Data Analyst to support the USAF Test Pilot School at Edwards AFB, CA.** **This position can be hybrid. It will require the ability and willingness to travel to Edwards AFB, CA up to 40%.** **The Data Analyst provides mid\-level data analysis and data\-engineering support for Doolittle Labs’ flight\-test campaigns and applied research. The Analyst executes day\-to\-day analysis under the technical direction of the Data Scientist and the Director of Data and Analytics, contributes to the lab’s data\-driven test infrastructure buildout, and interfaces with OEM partners and external sponsors on post\-event data.** **Responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to:*** Establish a “data\-driven test” infrastructure and process for Doolittle Labs, aligned with the AFTC Multi\-Domain Test Force (MDTF) and AFTC Data Working Group and VAULTIS\-compliant for integration into the DAF Data Mesh Environment (DME).
* Support all flight\-test activities executed by Doolittle Labs, including modeling and simulation (M\&S), test\-data planning, and data acquisition requirements definition.
* Support flight\-test data analysis post\-event, including data received from OEM partners (e.g., Lockheed Martin, RTX, Calspan, Boeing, Northrop Grumman, among others) and translation of OEM outputs into Doolittle Labs analysis products.
* Apply data\-analysis tools to quantify AI\-agent performance early—in simulation, HITL/SITL, and pre\-flight environments; before flight test on the X\-62A VISTA.
* Provide and disseminate flight\-test results to Doolittle Labs leadership, sponsors, PAE/PM reach\-back customers, and, where and when authorized and cleared, the broader T\&E community.
* Ensure that task related products are consistent in format and content with overall project deliverables \- Routinely engage with Govt technical representative \+ tech leads for our teammates and subcontractors
* Acts as a resource/mentor for colleagues with less experience
* Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations

 **Required Skills*** Working knowledge of applied statistical analysis, exploratory data analysis, and common machine\-learning techniques as applied to engineering data.
* Working knowledge of flight\-test practices (test cards, telemetry, post\-flight data reconstruction) is preferred, or a demonstrated ability to acquire that knowledge quickly.
* Awareness of the DAF Data Strategy (VAULTIS, DME) and DCWF data\-workforce framework; awareness of AFTC data\-infrastructure activities led by the MDTF and AFTC Data Working Group.
* Awareness of AI/autonomy T\&E concepts sufficient to support Data Scientist and Director\-level tasking, including basic V\&V considerations for nondeterministic systems.
* Proficiency with Python (e.g., pandas, NumPy, matplotlib) and SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Working proficiency with a data\-visualization platform (Tableau, Power BI, or plotly) sufficient to produce reviewable analysis products.
* Working proficiency with MATLAB and/or Excel for engineering\-data analysis; ability to work with structured telemetry files (CSV, HDF5, etc).
* Experience with data cleaning, quality checks, ETL construction, and basic pipeline maintenance.
* Skill in version control (e.g, Git) and reproducible\-analysis practices (Jupyter, notebook standards


All MTSI employees are required to be skilled in the following core competencies:* Collaboration/Teamwork: Engages others across roles through communication and mutual respect, shares insights, enabling effective teamwork to ensure collective success. (teamwork)
* Technical and Functional Skills: Leverages technical and functional expertise to deliver high performance, addresses challenges, and supports business needs while pursuing continuous skill development. (domain knowledge)
* Entrepreneurialism: Fosters innovation, evaluates ideas, and advances initiatives with sound judgment and organizational awareness to drive growth and impact. (innovation)
* Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively, fostering understanding, collaboration, and alignment through active listening and impactful messaging. (effective communication)
* Customer Focus: Prioritizes customer needs, builds trust, and delivers exceptional service by using insights to drive improvements and strengthen relationships. (customer insight)

 **Desired Experience:*** Prior experience at AFTC, USAF Test Pilot School (TPS), TRMC, AFRL, DARPA, or an OEM flight\-test organization.
* Experience with X\-62A VISTA, F\-16 VENOM, Group 1\-3 UAS, or similar AI\-in\-the\-loop flight\-test programs.
* Familiarity with VAULTIS\-compliant data products or DAF Data Mesh Environment integration.
* Publication record in flight\-test T\&E, AI evaluation, or related peer\-reviewed venues.
* Familiarity with VAULTIS / DAF Data Mesh Environment data\-product concepts.
* Within driving distance of a SCIF preferred

 **Education Requirements:*** B.S. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Aerospace or Systems Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline.

 **Travel:*** This position will require up to 40% travel to Edwards AFB, CA.

 **Clearance Requirements:*** Active Secret clearance is required
* Ability to qualify for and maintain a TS/SCI clearance

 **U.S. Citizenship is required**

**This position is on site in Beverly Hills, CA.** Tower Cancer Research Foundation is looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented coordinator to join their team. **Tower Cancer Research Foundation** is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing innovative cancer research, funding clinical trials, and providing compassionate patient support programs. With a primary focus on Southern California, Tower Cancer Research Foundation accelerates more effective treatments while supporting patients and families through survivorship and community education initiatives.

Working for Tower Cancer Research Foundation means being part of a mission\-driven organization where your work has a direct, meaningful impact. Every project supports groundbreaking cancer research and compassionate patient programs, allowing you to help advance better treatments while making a real difference in the lives of patients, families, and the local community—every single day.

**POSITION SCOPE:**

This position would be responsible for assisting the YLI director in the administration of events, communications and fundraising. They will aid in building bridges through networking with leaders in Churches of Christ and Restoration churches as well as prospective students from those churches. They will also oversee and train student workers who serve in the CrossWays Christian leadership training event as well as student workers in the Church Relations office.

new_jobs.title: LVN / LPT Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
Stronger Roots – Recuperative Care ProgramFull\-Time \| In\-Person

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does not come to work with the mindset:

“I finished my job, so I’m done.”

We want someone who thinks:

“What else needs to happen, and how can I help the team be successful?”

Stronger Roots operates with a small, hands\-on team. You will have your own caseload and responsibilities, but you must also be willing to notice gaps, help with an intake, follow up on an unresolved issue, support a teammate, and step in when the program reasonably needs help.

We need someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates, solves problems, and does not need to be told every next step.

About the Position

Stronger Roots is seeking a California Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) for our Recuperative Care program.

This is not a traditional nursing position. It is a clinical case\-management role combining behavioral\-health support, client engagement, care coordination, documentation, and clinical follow\-up.

Our clients are often more behavioral\-health focused than medically intensive, with mental health, substance\-use, and co\-occurring conditions. Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, although we are willing to train the right candidate.

The position manages approximately 35–40 clients and works closely with our RN, case\-management team, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage a caseload of approximately 35–40 clients.
* Complete and assist with intakes, assessments, care plans, and discharge planning.
* Maintain regular client contact and identify medical, behavioral\-health, substance\-use, and social\-service needs.
* Complete daily progress notes and required case\-management documentation.
* Review medical records, medications, discharge instructions, behavioral\-health information, and provider recommendations.
* Provide clinical support within the LVN/LPT scope of practice and appropriately escalate concerns.
* Coordinate medical care, behavioral health, psychiatry, substance\-use treatment, pharmacy, Home Health, specialty services, and other community resources.
* Coordinate appointments, referrals, transportation, prescriptions, and provider follow\-up.
* Communicate with hospitals, Managed Care Plans, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.
* Participate in case conferences and interdisciplinary team meetings.
* Help clients address barriers involving treatment, medications, benefits, housing, transportation, and recovery.
* Maintain accurate and timely electronic records.

Preferred Experience

Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with individuals with:

* Mental health conditions and serious mental illness
* Substance\-use disorders
* Co\-occurring mental health and substance\-use disorders
* Trauma and behavioral dysregulation
* Medication\-adherence challenges
* Homelessness and housing instability
* Difficulty consistently engaging in treatment

Experience in psychiatric services, behavioral health, substance\-use treatment, crisis services, community mental health, Recuperative Care, homelessness services, or case management is a plus.

Qualifications

* Current California LVN or LPT license
* Strong communication, organization, and follow\-through
* Comfortable managing approximately 35–40 clients
* Strong professional boundaries and client\-engagement skills
* Ability to recognize and appropriately escalate clinical or behavioral\-health concerns
* Strong computer and Electronic Health Record (EHR) skills
* Ability to complete accurate and timely progress notes and electronic documentation
* Comfortable working independently while remaining part of a small interdisciplinary team

Experience with trauma\-informed care, motivational interviewing, de\-escalation, crisis intervention, CPR/First Aid, Narcan, Medi\-Cal/CalAIM, or ECM is preferred.

Important

This is a full\-time, in\-person, boots\-on\-the\-ground position.

It is not a work\-from\-home position and is not intended for someone looking for a second job or simply additional nursing hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to join the team, take ownership of their clients, and help the entire program succeed.

Employment Statement

Stronger Roots is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with Stronger Roots is at will, meaning either the employee or Stronger Roots may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities as required by law.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you agree to read the entire job posting?

Experience:

* Case management or direct patient care: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* LVN /LPT (Required)

Work Location: On the road
